thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api (edge: eu-west1) queue depth rising rapidly (>4000). p95=2.1s p99=12.4s. Provisioner errors observed: \"quota_exceeded\" on GPU create. Auto-scale attempts failing.
sofia (oncall): Taking this. Paging infra + runtime. Oncall lead: sofia (in channel).
arjun: Looking at provisioner logs now, pinging cloud quotas and provisioner leader.
ops-bot: Provisioner error snippet:
```
ERROR 1719030105 provisioner.go:217 createInstance failed: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project, quotaExceeded
stack: provisioner.Create -> cloudApi.Insert -> googleapi: Error 403
```
maya-eng: Traffic telemetry shows a sudden fanout from a third-party partner campaign (cmp-493) starting at ~1719029950. 5k concurrent small requests, most hitting edge routing.
sofia (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan (short):
  1) Enable fallback routing to smaller, quantized model (redwood-gpt-small-q4) for non-critical keys
  2) Apply temporary global rate-limit to anonymous/unverified tokens (10 rps)
  3) Restart provisioner leader and open quota request with cloud provider
Assigning: arjun -> provisioner / infra ops, ben-platform -> routing + rate-limit, maya-eng -> traffic source tracer, customer-success -> customer comms.
arjun: Restarting provisioner leader now, will tail logs. `kubectl -n provisioner rollout restart deploy/provisioner-leader`
ops-bot: Provisioner leader restart triggered at 1719030230. Heartbeat regained at 1719030246.
ben-platform: Fallback routing enabled for route `edge/*` -> `redwood-gpt-small-q4` (checked via config hash `cfg:3a7f`). Noncritical keys flagged via header `x-rw-tier=best-effort`.
sofia (oncall): Applying WAF rule to cap anonymous tokens: `limit_req zone=anon burst=20 nodelay` deployed.
maya-eng: Confirmed traffic source throttled at upstream partner; partner acked and paused campaign.
sofia (oncall): Early signals — queue growth slowed within 120s after fallbacks; p99 down from 12.4s -> 3.2s. Still seeing timeouts on long-context (>2k tokens) calls.
customer-success: Triage note: ~12 customers reported elevated errors/timeouts, mostly medium priority. Opened CS ticket RW-5432, notifying account owners.
arjun: Cloud quota request opened (case: GCP-987654). In parallel, I'm patching provisioner to avoid tight coupling with single pool allocation (temp fix: allow cross-pool allocation).
sofia (oncall): Will keep fallback live for 30m while quota request in progress. If we see re-growth escalate to oncall2 and infra-sre. Logging runbook step: `/runbook gpu-spike-edge` executed.
ben-platform: Minor note: autoscaler was in backoff loop due to repeated create failures; after leader restart the create attempts resumed and some GPUs allocated but not enough to absorb initial spike. Recommend we add quota-aware prechecks in autoscaler.
sofia (oncall): Customer impact summary for postmortem: rapid third-party fanout -> edge hotspot -> provisioner hit cloud GPU quota -> autoscaler failed to provision -> request queue backlog spike -> p99 latency blowup -> fallbacks/rate-limits restored baseline.
arjun: Captured logs + timeline -> uploading to /incidents/1719030000/artifacts (provisioner.log, metrics dump, cloud errors).
sofia (oncall): Next steps:
 - Leave fallback for 30m, then gradually drain to normal routing.
 - Infra to follow up with cloud quota support and consider reserve pools for edge regions.
 - Platform to build quota alarm and prewarm path.
 - Eng to run a postmortem with timeline and action items.
leo (oncall-night): Acked. I'll watch dashboards for the rest of the shift and escalate if queue > 1k again. Handing off to night oncall.
sofia (oncall): Thanks team. Short summary to execs and CS to follow. :thumbsup:
